insert into basket_match_data_submission_material (submission_id, match_id, file_id, material_type, material_name, sort_no, material_status, remark, create_time, update_time, is_delete) values
(#{item.submissionId}, #{item.matchId}, #{item.fileId}, #{item.materialType}, #{item.materialName}, #{item.sortNo}, #{item.materialStatus}, #{item.remark}, #{item.createTime}, #{item.updateTime}, #{item.isDelete})
mapper.select: select id, submission_id as submissionId, match_id as matchId, file_id as fileId, material_type as materialType, material_name as materialName, sort_no as sortNo, material_status as materialStatus, remark, create_time as createTime, update_time as updateTime, is_delete as isDelete from basket_match_data_submission_material where submission_id = #{submissionId} and is_delete = 0 order by sort_no, id

select m.id, m.file_id as fileId, m.material_type as materialType, m.material_name as materialName, fa.access_url as fileUrl, fa.mime_type as fileType, fa.file_size as fileSize, fa.create_time as uploadTime, m.sort_no as sortNo from basket_match_data_submission_material m left join basket_file_asset fa on fa.id = m.file_id and fa.is_delete = 0 where m.submission_id = #{submissionId} and m.is_delete = 0 order by m.sort_no, m.id
